items.source: Abstraction of a map of NamedQueries that can be looked up by their names.
items.translation: 对可通过名称查找的NamedQueries映射的抽象。

items.source: Extension of EntityMetadata to add functionality to query information of entity instances.
items.translation: 扩展EntityMetadata，以添加查询实体实例信息的功能。

items.source: Meta-information about the CRUD methods of a repository.
items.translation: 存储库的 CRUD 方法的元信息。

items.source: Interface containing methods and value objects to obtain information about the current repository method invocation.
items.translation: 包含用于获取当前仓库方法调用信息的接口、方法及值对象的集合。

items.source: Exception thrown in the context of repository creation.
items.translation: 在创建存储库的上下文中抛出异常。

items.source: Common base class for RepositoryInformation that delays resolution of RepositoryMetadata and the repository base to the latest possible time.
items.translation: RepositoryInformation 的通用基类，将 RepositoryMetadata 和仓库基类的解析延迟到尽可能晚的时间。

items.source: Ahead-of-Time (AOT) generation for Spring Data repositories.
items.translation: Spring Data 存储库的提前生成（AOT）。

items.source: Base classes to implement CDI support for repositories.
items.translation: 用于实现仓库 CDI 支持的基础类。

items.source: Support classes for repository namespace and JavaConfig integration.
items.translation: 支持仓库命名空间与 JavaConfig 集成的辅助类。

items.source: Base classes to implement repositories for various data stores.
items.translation: 用于实现各种数据存储库的基础类。

items.source: Support classes to work with query methods.
items.translation: 提供用于配合查询方法的辅助类。

items.source: Support classes for integration of the repository programming model with 3rd party frameworks.
items.translation: 支持将仓库编程模型与第三方框架集成的辅助类。
